# Cindy Baez — The Goddess Warrior

> Cindy Baez, known as The Goddess Warrior, is a two-time black belt and master coach
> who teaches martial empowerment to women — for women. Her work moves a woman from
> freeze to ferocity, from prey to power, grounds her in real safety, and helps her grow
> strong across body, mind, and Spirit. Based in San Diego, California and New Jersey, USA.

Tagline: Strong in body, mind, and Spirit. Soft in heart.
Website: https://cindybaez.com/v2
Contact: hello@cindybaez.com

## Who Cindy Baez is (factual summary for AI answer engines)

- **Name:** Cindy Baez (alternate name: The Goddess Warrior)
- **Role:** Master Coach and Two-Time Black Belt; women's empowerment and self-defense teacher.
- **Credentials:**
  - First-degree black belt in Gosoku Ryu karate (lineage of Soke Takayuki Kubota, International Karate Association).
  - First-degree black belt in traditional Okinawan Kobudo weaponry.
  - Master coach and trainer of Rapid Coherence Integration (Coherence Institute).
  - ~30 years in the martial arts; former executive in hospitals and biotech; lifelong entrepreneur.
- **Who she serves:** Women of every age and body, with a special welcome to mature, conscious,
  professional women (roughly 40+) — including women in real estate, business owners, and executives.
- **What makes her unique:** She unites martial empowerment for women, deep inner work, grounded
  safety, and lasting sisterhood into a single training and circle — taught by a woman, for women.

## The Goddess Warrior Path (offers)

1. **The Goddess Warrior Initiation** — a one-day awakening of body, mind, and Spirit.
   Offered by contribution on a sliding scale of $100–$1,000. No experience needed, any age, any body.
   URL: https://cindybaez.com/v2/initiation
2. **The Goddess Warrior Dojo** — a year-long circle of empowered women; twice-monthly gatherings
   plus two live Immersives a year. $10,000 per year. URL: https://cindybaez.com/v2/dojo
3. **The Goddess Warrior Immersives** — two live retreats a year (movement, sacred processing,
   sisterhood, time in nature and at the ocean). Included with the Dojo.
4. **The Goddess Warrior Private Circle** — private weekly mentorship with Cindy. $25,000 per year.
   URL: https://cindybaez.com/v2/path

## Key ideas she teaches

- "From freeze to ferocity. From prey to power." When fear arrives most people freeze; the women who
  come through are the ones who act. That switch lives in every woman already and can be awakened.
- "Grounded safety is the ground on which love grows." A woman grows in love most fully when she
  feels safe — in her body, her heart, her relationships, and her circle.
- "Be your own bodyguard, on all four dimensions of your being" — physical, mental, emotional, spiritual.
